description: This file defines the Converters class and several nested converter classes for transforming between JSON, GenericValue, and other data types within the Apache OFBiz entity framework. It includes methods for converting JSON to GenericValue, vice versa, and utility conversions like wrapping a GenericValue in a list or set.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: Main class providing static nested converter classes for JSON and GenericValue transformations, implementing the ConverterLoader interface.

classes.name: JSONToGenericValue
classes.description: Converts JSON objects to GenericValue instances by mapping JSON fields to entity fields.

classes.name: GenericValueToJSON
classes.description: Converts GenericValue instances to JSON objects, including delegator and entity name metadata.

classes.name: GenericValueToList
classes.description: Wraps a single GenericValue into a List containing that value.

classes.name: GenericValueToSet
classes.description: Wraps a single GenericValue into a Set containing that value.

classes.name: GenericValueToString
classes.description: Converts a GenericValue to its string representation.

classes.name: NullFieldToObject
classes.description: Converts a NullField to a null Object.

classes.name: ObjectToNullField
classes.description: Converts an Object to a NullField.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters into the global conversion registry.
